source.title: Glossary
source.description: Definitions disambiguating near-synonyms — subagents versus agent teams, connectors versus MCP servers, sandboxing versus permission rules — plus renamed terms like headless mode, each linking its owning doc.

source.title: Best practices for Claude Code
source.description: Verification loops Claude can close itself, plan mode before implementing, lean `CLAUDE.md` versus on-demand skills, `/clear` and subagents to reclaim context, parallel and headless runs, and common failure patterns.

source.title: Tools reference
source.description: Catalogue of built-in tools with exact names used in permission rules, subagent `tools` lists, and hook matchers; the `ToolName(specifier)` format; per-tool behaviour for `Bash`, `Read`, `Edit`, `Grep`, `WebFetch`, `EndConversation`.

source.title: Configure permissions
source.description: Deny-first precedence over `ask`, `allow`, rule specificity and `PreToolUse` hooks; `Tool(specifier)` syntax; gitignore-anchored `Read`/`Edit` as the only file-path rules; `acceptEdits`/`plan`/`bypassPermissions` modes; managed settings; workspace trust gating project allow rules.

source.title: Extend Claude with skills
source.description: `SKILL.md` frontmatter gating invocation (`disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`), directory location deciding the `/name` typed, `$ARGUMENTS` and `!command` injection, backgrounded `context: fork` runs, `skill-creator` evals, and why Cowork or routines miss `~/.claude/skills/`.

source.title: Create plugins
source.description: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` as the only file inside `.claude-plugin/`, with `skills/`, `agents/`, `hooks/`, `.mcp.json` at the plugin root; `claude plugin init` for skills-directory plugins, `--plugin-dir` testing, converting `.claude/` config, marketplace submission.

source.title: Plugins reference
source.description: Every `plugin.json` field — `workflows`, `lspServers`, `userConfig`, `experimental.monitors` — plus the hook-event table, the full `claude plugin` subcommand surface, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` versus update-surviving `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}`, install scopes, cache eviction.

source.title: Create custom subagents
source.description: `.claude/agents/` definition files with `tools`, `model`, `permissionMode`, `skills`, `memory`, `hooks` frontmatter, scope precedence, built-in Explore/Plan; `@`-mention, `--agent`, `/subtask` forks inheriting conversation; background runs narrow tools; env-var nesting and spawn caps.

source.title: Manage multiple agents with agent view
source.description: Terminal dashboard from `claude agents` for background sessions: dispatch with `--bg` or `/bg`, peek and attach to rows, `.claude/worktrees/` edit isolation, and the supervisor process that hosts them.

source.title: Run Claude Code programmatically
source.description: `--bare` skips hook/plugin/MCP discovery for reproducible CI; `--output-format json`/`stream-json` carries `--json-schema` results, `system/init` load errors and subagent messages; `--allowedTools` and permission modes auto-approve; stdin piping and `--continue`/`--resume` multi-turn sessions.
